content.english: You are holy, You who do mighty deeds,
You perform kindnesses, and take account of barren women.
Great are Your deeds, and I cannot count them.
You let Yourself be beseeched by Isaac, Your beloved—You who answer supplication!
Adonai’s utterances are pure utterances:

content.hebrew: בִּשֵּׁר לְרִבְקָה בְּבֹא לָהּ צָרָה כְּמַבְכִּירוֹת:
content.transliteration: Bisser leRivḳa bevo lah tsara kemavkirot:
content.english: He announced to Rebecca, when she was distressed as a woman in [her] first pregnancy:
“Two nations are in your womb—hear the news!
And the older will serve the younger, [who will be] established for generations.”
Behold, the first one was born, and his hands were hairy,
But his heels were restrained by the hand of his brother—
An omen for him for the day of rage.
For a lentil stew, [Esau] sold his birthright;

content.hebrew: כִּי לֹא נָאֶה לְנָבָל שִׂפְתֵי יְתֵרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Ki lo na’ē lenaval siftē yeterot.
content.english: Because excessive speech is not appropriate for a wastrel.

content.hebrew: וְכִרְאוֹת אִישׁ תָּם כִּי הוּא פֹּרֵץ גְּדֵרוֹת,
content.transliteration: Vekhir’ot ish tam ki hu porets gederot,
content.english: And when the mild man saw that [Esau] was breaching fences,
He listened to his mother’s voice—peace like rivers,
And he was blessed with blessings, decreed by the Holy Spirit—

content.hebrew: אוֹת "גַּם בָּרוּךְ יִהְיֶה" הִסְכִּים אָבִיו בְּמִלּוֹת בְּרוּרוֹת.
content.transliteration: Ot “gam barukh yihyeh” hiskim aviv bemillot berurot.
content.english: “He, too, will be blessed” [being] the sign that his father confirmed [them], with clear words.
For all decrees are decreed from the One on high.
Together, the [angels] above and [people] below sing their acknowledgement
To God, who is praised with hymns and chants.
The [heavenly] creatures look upon God’s ways, and glorify [Him];
They constantly declare the nobility of His name.

content.transliteration: Vetamid en lo dimyon bekhol haytsirot,
content.english: Nothing is ever like Him, among all creations,
For all things are created by Him—

content.hebrew: קהל: וּמַה דְּמוּת נַעֲרֹךְ לוֹ, כְּדֵעוֹת הַנִּבְעָרוֹת?
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Uma demut na‘arokh lo, kede‘ot hanniv‘arot?
content.english: Congregation:So what comparison could we make to Him, as foolish minds [profess to do]?

content.hebrew: חזן: לְמִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְתַשְׁו֑וּ וְתַמְשִׁל֖וּנִי וְנִדְמֶֽה: (ישעיהו מו:ה)
content.english: To whom could you compare Me and declare Me similar, or liken Me, such that we could be compared? (Isa. 46:5)

content.hebrew: וְאֶל־מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ: (ישעיהו מ:כה)
content.transliteration: Ve’el mi tedammeyuni ve’eshvē yomar Ḳadosh:
content.english: And to whom could you compare Me, that I would be similar to them—says the holy One. (Isa. 40:25)

content.hebrew: קהל: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל: (תהלים כב:ד)
content.transliteration: Ḳahal: Ve’atta ḳadosh yoshev tehillot Yisra’el:
content.english: Congregation: And You are holy, enthroned on Israel’s praises. (Ps. 22:4)
